description.zh:
外发投递配置内容，以一系列参数构造的 JSON 格式转化成字符串。

> 与**CreateLogDeliveryConfig**接口的**DeliveryDetail**参数相同。相关描述，请参见[CreateLogDeliveryConfig](~~CreateLogDeliveryConfig~~)接口的**外发投递配置内容参数描述**。
description.en:
The details of the log delivery configuration, in JSON format.

> The value of this parameter is the same as the **DeliveryDetail** parameter of the **CreateLogDeliveryConfig** operation. For more information, see [CreateLogDeliveryConfig]().

description.zh: 要修改的外发投递配置名称。
description.en: The name of the log delivery configuration that you want to modify.

description.zh:
要修改的外发投递配置类型。取值为：

- **syslog**：表示外发到syslog服务。
- **kafka**：表示外发到kafka服务。
description.en:
The type of the log delivery destination. Valid values:

- **syslog**: delivers logs to a syslog server.

- **kafka**: delivers logs to a Kafka cluster.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)获取当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the resource group.

title.zh: 修改混合云日志外发投递配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-log-delivery-config --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --delivery-name test1 --delivery-type syslog --delivery-detail rfcVersion_:_rfc3164_,_protocol_:_tcp_,_servers_:_address_:_1.1.1.1_,_port_:_20 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyLogDeliveryConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --DeliveryName test1 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DeliveryDetail 'rfcVersion_:_rfc3164_,_protocol_:_tcp_,_servers_:_address_:_1.1.1.1_,_port_:_20' --DeliveryType syslog
